---
name: Content or citation error
about: A claim, citation, date, license statement, or status label is wrong
labels: documentation
---

## The claim as currently written

Quote the sentence (and give the file + line or section heading).

## What is wrong

The specific defect: unsupported claim, wrong date, mis-cited source,
overstated access level, license mislabel, status/maturity mismatch, or a
dead link.

## The source that supports the correction

URL and what it actually establishes (title, version/edition, date, license
as stated there). If you read the full text, say so; if you are reporting
from memory, say that too — the register records access levels for a reason.

## Suggested correction

The replacement text, if you have one.
